title: WsDbConfig
description: Canonical JSON contract for WsDbConfig in jocaagura_domain.

throwOnSave.description: Whether save operations simulate an error.

throwOnDelete.description: Whether delete operations simulate an error.

emitInitial.description: Whether streams emit an initial snapshot.

deepCopies.description: Whether deep copies are performed on write and emit.

dedupeByContent.description: Whether repeated equal content emissions are skipped.

orderCollectionsByKey.description: Whether collection snapshots are emitted sorted by key.

idKey.description: JSON key used for the document identifier.
